target_claim: Past verified action plus unchanged textual scope suffices to select a correct action after arbitrary hidden environment change without fresh distinguishing evidence.
worlds: H_s=s*omega*Z/2 with s in {-1,+1}, known omega=1; prepare +X; past/current accessible readout is X; unobserved sign may change after the original verification
baseline: Exact Bayesian posterior over signs, equal current-world prior; X-only history has identical likelihoods in both worlds
fresh_probe_ablation: Allow a Y measurement after pi/2 evolution; outcome identifies the sign with probability 1-readout_error; both memory policy and baseline have equal access
classical_control: Hidden classical bit with identical history distribution and a binary symmetric diagnostic; same decision bound
prediction: X probabilities match to 1e-12 for every time; at pi/2 correct sign-conditioned correction has fidelity 1 and wrong one 0; no X-only randomized decision exceeds 1/2 average success under equal sign prior; Y probe yields 1-error
statistics: Exact finite enumeration and analytic symmetry, no stochastic significance or physical measurement claim
falsifier_of_counterexample: Any X likelihood differs by >1e-12, pi/2 fidelity matrix differs from predicted diagonal by >1e-12, or fresh diagnostic disagrees with analytic error rates
decision: If the counterexample checks, reject only the universal scope-alone transfer claim. Do not infer that WaveMind itself makes that claim or that all useful memory transfer is impossible.
